1thōrāx lāneus: lāneus, “woollen” (Traupman 118 thōrāx lānius). Lewis & Short s.v. lāneus, citing the woollen thōrāx of Suet. Aug. 82; the libellī write lāneus.

thōrāx lāneus1

Examples

    shirts, trousers, socks, vests, pyjamas, woollen jumpers, a cap, one coat: he had wanted two, Mum had said oneLibellus I, Iter in Lūsitāniam
